title: Winter and Visitor
author: V. M. Nakamura
blurb: Jonah Galloway, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
